title: KernelCommand
responsibility: Registers the harness kernel parity, bench, default, serve and sample commands.

inputs.name: registerKernelCommand.program
inputs.description: The parent Commander Command instance on which the kernel command tree is registered. It must support the command, option, description, and action methods used here; this function applies no additional validation or explicit limits.

outputs.name: registerKernelCommand
outputs.description: No value is returned; the supplied Command is extended with the kernel command and its parity, bench, default, serve, and sample subcommands. The implementation defines no additional result or output limit.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised through fail when the parity report contains one or more problems, after the parity result has been printed. This error path applies to the registered parity action.
